verdict.rationale: v0 lets users push generated code to their own GitHub repository as standard code, and its Platform API lists 'export capabilities for backup and migration', so the generated code can leave the platform in an open form. The evidence does not show that all account data (chats, prompts, design-system settings, project configuration) can be exported, or in what formats. Missing for 10: documented full-account data export covering chats, history, design systems and project settings; specified open export formats; independent or hands-on confirmation of a complete migration off v0.
